ownership_rule: The vocabulary database of this computer (data/qnc-shot-vocabulary.db), outside every project: the same vocabulary for every project. qnc.module.shot-vocabulary is its only writer.

rules.set: A row a model: the text vectors of the vocabulary list (code, prompt, vector) and how the model scores a picture against a text (scale, bias).
rules.replace: Made again when the list says something else than the kept terms and prompts.
